Do you feel like the same person in February as in June? For most people, the answer is a resounding no.Subscribe to skip adsFeatured VideoDuring winter, your energy tends to dip, your immune system takes a hit and you may feel less social. Research finds that people are less inclined to stick to a workout routine in winter.In contrast, spring’s longer days can make you feel like you’re coming alive with energy, with summer reported as the most active and social of the seasons.Subscribe to skip adsAdvertisement
